info.title: Ploid Public API
info.description: Ploid's focused agent-native people API. Start with 50 ACU for 30 days after creating an account.

post.summary: Find candidate identities in the people index for 1 ACU
post.description: Return up to 10 basic indexed profiles matching all name terms plus optional company, location, and title filters. Requires people:search; legacy full-access keys with both people:enrich and agent:chat are accepted. Costs 1 ACU per completed search, including zero matches; failed searches are not charged. Never starts research or enrichment. Normal account billing, auto-recharge settings, and API-key spending caps apply. Send an Idempotency-Key to replay a request without another charge. Indexed identities and employment are unverified. Ask the user to choose before POST /v1/person, which costs 25 ACU unless the workspace already has active access. One bounded index request; no exhaustive count or pagination. Workspace limits: 30 requests/minute and 300/hour across keys. Active account eligibility still applies.

post.summary: Run a bounded tool-calling model request
post.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completion transport with Ploid-owned model routing. Requests are capped at 128 KB, 100 messages, 32 tools, 4,096 output tokens, a 90-second total upstream lifetime, and a 1 MB response. stream=true returns SSE and must omit Idempotency-Key. Requires agent:chat.

post.description: Retrieve up to 150 people inline per request; async:true or a larger num_results starts a background People Set instead and returns 202 with set_id, items_url and events_url. instant and fast return indexed candidates. auto and deep research the complete query and explicit filters before returning matches with verification references; uncertain and rejected candidates are excluded from results, grounding and billing. Auto/deep compile the query, verify candidates, and run one bounded web recovery pass when too few match. Each verification pass permits up to 30 seconds for auto or 45 seconds for deep; recovery discovery permits 45 or 60 seconds respectively. A partial status means the requested count was not filled or verification hit its deadline. Use Sets for durable research of large result sets. Verification is evidence-based model assessment, separate from identity verification. Requires people:search.

post.description: Identify one person from a full name plus at least one clue (company name or domain, role, location, address, work or personal email, or phone) by fusing the people index with live web results. Returns the permanent person_id accepted by /v1/person and /v1/enrich, so a deep profile is only bought for the right person. Costs 2 ACU when a person is found; no match is free. A match is model-assessed, not identity-verified. Requires people:search.

post.description: Resolve one reviewed deep person profile. An eligible cached profile returns 200, including stale data with a queued refresh. Unseen people and snapshots requiring new review return a durable 202 run. Fresh research can take minutes; poll the returned run ID. A completed uncertain identity returns data:null with meta.resolution=unsure and reason ambiguous_identity or insufficient_evidence. The first successful profile costs exactly 25 ACU on every plan; organization-wide rereads are free for 90 days. Failed, uncertain, and not-found runs are free. Current role fields, age, and social audience/activity metrics are not populated by the current reviewed projection.

post.description: Resolve contact fields for one person using a LinkedIn URL, permanent person_id, work email with first and last name, or name plus company domain. Request work_email, personal_email, and/or phone; every field reports found, not_found, or unavailable with confidence, source, and last_seen. Responses include explicit usage.billed and usage.not_found. The legacy lightweight LinkedIn profile contract remains supported; use /v1/person for deep public evidence. Requires the people:enrich scope.

http_status.description: Semantic status when an error terminates a response after streaming headers opened.

unavailable_fields.description: Requested enrichment fields that could not complete. Present when all requested fields are unavailable.

model.description: Ploid Atlas uses Luna; Ploid Ox uses Sol.

HarnessChatCompletionResponse.description: OpenAI-compatible completion payload with internal model/provider routing metadata removed.

query.description: Optional semantic query. Supply this, at least one structured filter, or both.

type.description: instant and fast return indexed candidates. auto and deep require evidence-backed matches to the complete query and filters; deep also always runs public-web grounding. Verification may return fewer results within its deadline; Sets supports durable research for larger requests.

num_results.description: Up to 150 return inline. Larger requests run as a background People Set (self-serve up to 500).

criteria.description: Plain-English conditions every result must satisfy, such as 'Has founded a venture-backed company'. Each is researched and judged separately; results carry one verification entry per criterion and are ranked by evidence strength across all of them. Requires type auto or deep. In async searches they replace the criteria derived from the query.

async.description: Run as a background People Set and return 202 with set_id. Defaults to true above 150 results; false with a larger num_results is rejected. Async searches always verify each row, so type and contents do not apply.

webhook_url.description: Async searches only. Receives the Set's progress events.

namesakes.description: Bare-name searches: further verified people with the requested name. Not billed.

total_time_ms.description: Total search processing time, including planning, retrieval and verification.

has_more.description: More candidates existed than were checked or returned.

person_id.description: Stable Ploid identity. Deep person enrichment currently requires a linked LinkedIn profile.

profile_url.description: Canonical public profile or individual biography when discovered outside LinkedIn.

confidence.description: Retrieval confidence normalized to 0..1; null when the source has no confidence score.

contact_status.description: LinkedIn contact fields can be resolved through POST /v1/enrich. Results without LinkedIn report unavailable.

location_match.description: Verified searches with a location: whether the person's own location names the requested place or only lies inside it.

SyncSearchPerson.description: Only resolved people are returned. Requested profile fields are present when selected and may be null when the people index has no value.

criteria.description: Criteria every admitted row is verified against.

pricing.description: Estimate; billing settles on admitted rows.

items_url.description: Page admitted rows, usable while the search runs.

name.description: Full name; a partial or misspelled surname is tolerated.

company.description: Company name or web domain, such as Acme or acme.com.

address.description: Street or mailing address; it only has to fit the person's area.

work_email.description: Work email. Its domain identifies the employer unless it is a free mailbox provider.

phone.description: Phone number with 7 to 15 digits, in any common format.

profiles.description: Profiles found while resolving. Missing platforms are omitted; more_profiles shows how to look for more.

more_profiles.description: Present when found. A ready-to-send /v1/person request that looks for more public profiles.

query.example: New LinkedIn posts from Nvidia about AI chips

type.description: `text` returns `{ summary }` per item. `object` returns the schema you give or one derived from the query.

schema.description: JSON Schema with an object root, at most 25 properties.

description.description: Describe the fields in prose, or paste example JSON or a JSON Schema, to derive `schema`.

relevance_criteria.description: Every item must satisfy this to be emitted. Null emits all new activity.

kind.description: `company` is LinkedIn-only; elsewhere brand accounts are profiles.

identifier.description: Profile or company URL or @handle; search terms for keyword; tag without # for hashtag. Instagram supports hashtags but not keyword search.

events.description: Defaults to posts. Topics support posts only.

cron.description: Five-field cron. The minute field must be a single value, so runs happen at most hourly.

status.description: `skipped` means available ACU or the API-key budget could not cover the run; `error` explains which.

MonitorItem.description: Webhook events: monitor.run.completed, monitor.run.failed, monitor.run.skipped. monitor.run.completed is sent only when a run emits items and carries up to 100 of them.

output.description: Object matching the monitor's output schema, or null when extraction failed.

source.description: Normalized text, author, metrics and event details.

platform.description: Use x for new integrations; twitter remains a compatibility alias.

identifier.description: Handle, vanity slug, or a profile URL belonging to the selected platform.

profile.description: Public profile fields vary by platform. Internal routing metadata is removed.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

oneOf.description: Items joined with spaces must total at most 200 characters.

data.description: Provider-neutral LinkedIn data. Fields vary by the selected read operation and internal credentials and status fields are removed.

EnrichContactRequest.description: Canonical contact-resolution contract for new integrations.

email.description: Work email to look up from; requires first_name and last_name.

EnrichLegacyRequest.description: Legacy lightweight profile/contact contract. New integrations should use EnrichContactRequest.

data.description: Only requested contact fields are present.
Only requested enrichment fields are present; an unavailable field is null.

acu_value_usd.description: Fixed USD value of one ACU.
